criteria.reason: Uses simple words, concrete rulebook/petition/school-vote images, and short sentences suitable for a 10-year-old.
Omits required 100,000 signatures and 18-month deadline, so core facts are not correctly included.
Clear numbered steps, concrete analogies, and concise length make it engaging and proportionate.

factual_errors: Says only lawmakers can change the constitution, ignoring popular initiatives.
summary: Child-friendly and engaging, but it omits the required 100,000-signature and 18-month facts and includes a misleading claim about who can change the constitution.
